art_direction: 水青底琥珀双眼，厚眼皮低低压下，无语地沉默片刻。
composition_variation: Keep both pupils centered and staring forward beneath particularly broad upper-lid brushstrokes. Open the viewer-left eye to twenty-five percent and the right to thirty-five percent, but retain clearly visible curved lower boundaries and colored bands rather than thin slits. Place the right eye slightly higher, with a medium-wide gap. Let a tiny difference in the outer lid ends carry the individuality. The heavy steady gaze should suggest a silent speechless pause, lucid and controlled, without anger or despair.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
